Schedule: 1:00 AM to 10:00 AM (Tues - Sat) JOB SCOPE The ERP Implementation Manager is responsible for managing and overseeing the full lifecycle of ERP solution implementations, currently centered on NetSuite, ensuring successful integration and driving client adoption. This role leads multiple projects teams, manages project timelines, and coordinates with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of NetSuite and other ERP implementations within scope and budget. The Manager will leverage their extensive experience to guide the implementation process, ensure quality, and provide strategic direction. The Manager is expected to be open and willing to learn and adapt to new ERP tools as AGO's ERP practice evolves. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Manage NetSuite and Other ERP Implementations: Oversee all stages of the NetSuite (and other ERP/related platform) implementation process, from planning and design to deployment, ensuring all phases align with client requirements, business goals, and timelines. Project Management: Manage project plans, schedules, risks, and cross-functional teams to ensure the on-time, on-budget delivery of NetSuite and other ERP/related platform solutions, while proactively addressing potential delays or challenges. Client Engagement: Work closely with clients to capture detailed requirements, configure NetSuite or other ERP/related platforms, and customize modules (such as Financials, CRM, Inventory, and Order Management) to meet their specific business needs. System Integration and Data Migration: Oversee the integration of NetSuite and other ERPs/related platforms with third-party systems and lead data migration efforts, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data as it transitions from legacy systems to NetSuite or the target ERP. Training and Post-Implementation Support: Provide comprehensive training sessions for clients and offer post-implementation support and client satisfaction. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain and manage project documentation, including configuration details, customizations, progress reports, and status updates, ensuring all activities are clearly tracked and communicated. Continuous Improvement: Provide leadership in identifying opportunities for process improvements, ensuring best practices are followed throughout the implementation and that the system evolves to meet changing business needs. QUALIFICATIONS : MINIMUM EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field. 6+ years of experience in NetSuite implementation or similar ERP implementation roles, with a proven track record of leading complex implementations from start to finish. Strong expertise in NetSuite ERP modules (Financials, CRM, Inventory, Order Management, etc.), with an in-depth understanding of accounting principles and business processes. Extensive experience in requirements gathering, solution design, system configuration, and testing. Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, handle multiple priorities, and successfully deliver projects on time and within budget. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with both clients and internal teams effectively at all levels. Strong understanding of accounting concepts. Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong problem-solving abilities and keen attention to detail. Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies. Open and willing to learn and adapt to new ERP tools and platforms beyond NetSuite. NetSuite certifications (e.g., NetSuite Certified ERP Consultant) are preferred. Preferred: Career goals that align with growing into a multi-ERP, platform-agnostic implementation leader. TECHNICAL AND OTHER SKILLS NetSuite Configuration and Customization: Expertise in configuring and customizing NetSuite modules (e.g., Financials, CRM, Inventory, Order Management) and workflows (e.g., Sales and Quote Development, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Financial Reporting). Business Process Analysis: Skilled in analyzing client business processes and mapping them to NetSuite functionality, driving system alignment and operational efficiency. Data Migration: Proficient in data migration techniques to ensure smooth and accurate data transitions from legacy systems to NetSuite. NetSuite Integration: Experience with integrating NetSuite to third-party systems such as CRM, e-commerce platforms, and financial systems (e.g., Salesforce, Shopify, Amazon Seller, UPS) to ensure seamless workflows and data exchanges. Project Management Tools: Strong proficiency with tools like ClickUp, Jira, or Monday.com to track milestones, timelines, and resource allocation throughout the project lifecycle. Change Management: Ability to guide clients through the transition, ensuring they understand and adapt to new business processes and NetSuite functionalities effectively. Testing and Quality Assurance: Knowledge of creating and executing test cases to validate the proper functioning of configurations, customizations, and system integrations. Client Training and Support: Experience in training clients on NetSuite functionalities and providing post-implementation support to troubleshoot issues and optimize system performance. Customer Service Support: Capable of handling ad-hoc NetSuite issues, addressing routine problems efficiently, and escalating complex issues for further specialized attention. System Documentation: Proficiency in creating detailed documentation for system configurations, customizations, training materials, and project progress reports.

Position: Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist II Location: Metro Manila Work setup & shift: Remote | Day Shift Why join MicroSourcing? You'll Have Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities. Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements. Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement. Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture. Role Overview The Data Strategy & Analytics team is a regionally distributed team of specialists supporting Kepler's expanding business in The Americas, Europe and Asia Pacific. The APAC team is based in the Philippines and Singapore, but will closely integrate with similar teams in London and Costa Rica to provide global support to the business and its clients. As a Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist II, you will play a key role in developing and optimizing the data infrastructure and reporting solutions for our global clients. You will need outstanding problem-solving abilities, strong data/analytics experience, and excellent English communication skills. What You Will Do Manage the ETL pipeline of digital media, third party, and client data streams across multiple clients – responsible for ingesting, QA, cleaning, transforming, and visualizing digital marketing performance data. Develop data visualizations, reports, and ad hoc analysis for both Kepler and client usage Unify disparate data sources into cohesive, cross-channel dashboards for both internal and client usage. Provide input and guidance around data visualization and reporting structures to Kepler team members Proactively identify trends and opportunities in performance data, working with team members to provide strategic insights that drive optimization and campaign strategy. Become an expert in the digital marketing ecosystem and in media analytics tools across digital channels, including display (banner ads), mobile (smartphone, tablet), search (Google, Bing), social (Facebook, Twitter) and online video (Hulu, YouTube), among others. Mentor and train new or junior team members on data best practices, tools, and proprietary software. Become an expert in Kepler's proprietary software suite. Codify and share best practices across teams. What You Need Must Have: 2+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, preferably in digital marketing or advertising. Strong analytical skills, comfortable with MS Excel, ability to think creatively about challenging problems. Strong proficiency with SQL Hands-on experience working with cloud-based data management tools like AWS S3, Athena and Amazon Glue Studio for ETL development Proven ability to manage ETL pipelines and automate data workflows Demonstrate experience in developing complex data visualizations and reports using platforms like Salesforce Datorama, Looker, PowerBI, or Tableau Proficiency in English Ability to manage, juggle multiple priorities, and pay strong attention to details. Ability to contribute to an entrepreneurial, team-based environment. Nice to Have A degree education Online advertising experience (e.g. Google Ads/Search Ads 360, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.). Experience with Python Experience mentoring or training junior team members --- About MicroSourcing With over 9,000 professionals across 13 delivery centers, MicroSourcing is the pioneer and largest offshore provider of managed services in the Philippines. Our commitment to 100% YOU MicroSourcing firmly believes that our company's strength lies in our people's diversity and talent. We are proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces individuals of all races, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds. We provide space for everyone, embracing different perspectives, and making room for opportunities for each individual to thrive. At MicroSourcing, equality is not merely a slogan – it's our commitment. Our way of life. Here, we don't just accept your unique authentic self - we celebrate it, valuing every individual's contribution to our collective success and growth. Join us in celebrating YOU and your 100%! For more information, visit https://www.microsourcing.com/ Terms & conditions apply

Drive sales and market development for Epiroc's ATD product portfolio through direct and dealer channels. Lead, coach, and support internal sales teams and dealer partners to achieve business targets. Build strong customer and business partner relationships to grow market share and customer satisfaction. Manage business performance, sales forecasts, budgets, and profitability objectives. Collaborate across functions to deliver effective sales, service, and market development initiatives. Je werkt nauw samen met productie, technische dienst, IT, R&D en externe partners om innovatieve en toekomstgerichte technische oplossingen succesvol te ontwerpen en uit te rollen. Ontwikkelen en implementeren van standaarden op vlak van automatisatie, industriële netwerken en cybersecurity binnen de productieomgevingen. Actief bijdragen aan de digitalisering van productielijnen via onder meer betrouwbare datacollectie, industriële dataplatformen en de integratie van operationele data voor monitoring, kwaliteitsopvolging en optimalisatie. Je volgt nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet, bouwt je expertise rond automatiseringssystemen en industriële data verder uit en deelt deze kennis actief binnen het engineeringteam en met de technische afdelingen van de verschillende fabrieken. Jouw profiel: Master industrieel ingenieur of burgerlijk ingenieur elektromechanica, automatisatie, Elektronica-ICT of een gelijkaardige technische opleiding. Minimum 4 jaar relevante werkervaring als automation engineer binnen een productie- of industriële omgeving. Je hebt een goede kennis van PLC-systemen (Siemens, Rockwell) en OT-systemen (MES). Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en bent proactief en oplossingsgericht. Je bent een enthousiaste teamspeler die graag initiatief neemt, kennis deelt en zich voortdurend verder wil ontwikkelen. Het aanbod: Zeer aantrekkelijk salaris, met de mogelijkheid tot een bedrijfswagen met laadkaart , aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket aan extralegale voordelen. 33 verlofdagen die je vrij kan opnemen, zonder collectief verlof. Glijdende werkuren en de mogelijkheid om 1 dag per week van thuis uit te werken.
